note: Curated seed catalog. VDOT publishes several hundred guidance documents; run tools/build-manifest.py to crawl the full published library and merge it into this file, then tools/build-corpus.py to attach full text.

divisions.label: Location & Design
divisions.scope: Roadway design, plan assembly, geometrics, drainage, right of way plans, CADD standards.

divisions.label: Structure & Bridge
divisions.scope: Bridge and culvert design, inspection, load rating, materials, plan approval authority.

divisions.label: Traffic Operations
divisions.scope: Traffic engineering, safety, work zones, signals, signing, incident management. Two series: IIM-TE and IIM-TO.

divisions.label: Environmental
divisions.scope: NEPA and state environmental review, permits, cultural resources, hazardous materials.

divisions.label: Transportation & Mobility Planning
divisions.scope: Planning studies, access management, SSAR, land use permits, corridor and multimodal planning.

divisions.label: Local Assistance
divisions.scope: Locally administered projects: the LAP Manual, Letters to Local Governments and Department Memoranda.

divisions.label: Materials
divisions.scope: Field sampling, inspection, testing and control of materials; Virginia Test Methods; QA/QC.

divisions.label: Construction
divisions.scope: Construction administration, inspection, documentation, post-construction closeout.

divisions.label: Right of Way & Utilities
divisions.scope: Acquisition, relocation assistance, appraisals, property management, utility relocation.

divisions.label: Maintenance
divisions.scope: Asset management, pavement and roadside maintenance, snow and ice, permits to work in the ROW.

divisions.label: Programming
divisions.scope: Six-Year Improvement Program, SMART SCALE, funding categories, project scoping and estimation.

divisions.label: Asset Management
divisions.scope: Maintenance & Operations Program budget and forecast, Special Structure Program, needs assessment and life-cycle cost analysis.

divisions.label: Civil Rights
divisions.scope: DBE program, Title VI nondiscrimination, contractor compliance, labor and prevailing wage.

divisions.label: Scheduling & Contract
divisions.scope: Advertisement, bidding, award and contract administration for construction projects.

divisions.label: Governance & Policy
divisions.scope: Department Memoranda, VDOT governance documents, policy issuances and the policy manual.
